7823e2fc27.rewrite:

sub r11,rdx
bsf rcx,r11
and rcx,0xfffffffffffffff8
sar rax,cl
movzx eax,al

movzx edx,dl

7823e2fc27.why: Arithmetic right shift by three followed by left shift by three simply clears the lowest three bits. A single 64-bit AND preserves rcx, and the final subtraction supplies the required flags.
